$comment: positive: a realistic request that must rank its own skill inside top_k (default 3).
negative: a request that belongs to a DIFFERENT skill; that owner must outrank this one.
Write prompts the way a person asks. Copying the description into the prompt games the check
and proves nothing. A skill with no entry here is reported as uncovered, not failed — add
cases as you touch each skill.
